messages.content: It is deeply understandable that you are exhausted by the effort of pretending or surviving something that feels like a constant punishment. Feeling like your value has been erased by shame is an agonizing burden to carry. While the impulse to simply stop fighting is a natural response to immense pain, giving up doesn't necessarily equal peace. Please let someone else help hold this unbearable weight for a while; connecting with a crisis line can offer immediate support without any demand for "rebuilding."
